description: Unit tests for parsing and converting X.509 distinguished names, including handling of various string encodings, OIDs, and RFC2253 formatting.

classes.name: X509NameAttribute
classes.description: Represents an attribute of an X.509 name, with methods to extract string values.

methods.name: LoadTestData
methods.description: Loads test data from a PEM file based on specified parameters.

methods.name: ParseName
methods.description: Parses DER-encoded distinguished name into a sequence of relative distinguished names.

methods.name: SequenceValueFromString
methods.description: Converts a string into a DER sequence for testing invalid cases.

methods.name: ConvertToRFC2253
methods.description: Converts parsed distinguished name into RFC2253 string format.
